selector_contract.budget_formula: 1 + maximum_sweeps * coordinate_count * values_per_coordinate = 1 + 8*27*7 = 1513; full ASH is 1 + 8*sum(40 declared domain cardinalities) = 1297

coordinates.candidate_order: coordinate order above, then ascending integer value
coordinates.sweep_rule: retain the best development-feasible value for each coordinate before advancing
coordinates.tie_break: lexicographically maximize the declared validation engine_raw corpus-mean tuple, then choose the lexicographically ascending canonical serialized complete rule vector

selector_contract.data_separation: For each exact shared-bank hash, tune selector coordinates only on development and choose only among the development terminal vector and one-coordinate neighbors on validation. The comparison result is bound to that bank; only the final selected bank's rule is frozen for P07.
forbidden_inputs_and_operations: ASH penalties, confidence, priors, or LUT dispatch
selector_contract.input_contract: Use the identical continuous cell-center features, exact target phase, route, chroma siting, analysis-grid assignment, and boundary policy as full ASH. Unsigned Q0.15 inputs are centered as 2*q-32767; signed orientation inputs are already Q0.15; route is -32767 for direct-2x and +32767 for direct-3over2.
selector_contract.output_cache: Cache all 16 operator outputs for each locked degraded input by source/degradation/route/operator/configuration hash; selector search may choose among cached outputs but cannot alter pixels.
selector_contract.score: For descriptor d, score is (bias_d_q8_8 << 15) plus the signed Int64 sum of weight_feature_q8_8 * feature_q15. Feature signs are derived only from descriptor axes: magnitude/coherence/orientation use support bit 1; texture/risk use detail bit 2; chroma/noise use limiter bit 3; phases/route use kernel bit 0. Sign is +1 for axis bit one and -1 for zero. Highest score wins; exact ties choose the smallest descriptor ID.

cold.scope: new native root and new evidence root

empirical_linear_time_projection.method: measured search-and-commit seconds divided by observed unique rules and scaled to 1297, plus observed adapter, operator-cache preparation/import, and close once per bank; the one-time factory setup is added once
empirical_linear_time_projection.projection_scope: non-ASH selector component only; not total P06 calibration

empirical_storage_projection.method: observed non-rule overhead with the development attempt ledger replaced by its 1513-record structural model and all known count-dependent shared documents replaced by their 1297-rule or 1513-attempt models, plus 1297 times the largest observed complete 21-file/39-inode rule footprint; allocated estimates use observed st_blocks with one filesystem-fragment floor for every file and directory
empirical_storage_projection.projection_limitations: empirical extrapolation; content variation outside the known rule-count and attempt-count dimensions, filesystem metadata behavior, contention, and future format changes are not bounded

holdout_statement: No holdout media, holdout pixels, or holdout split capability was accessed; the bound-input stub read only preregistered no-pixel holdout control documents.
